messages:
incident-bot: Paging: billing-metering anomaly detected — token-count drift on ingest pipeline (threshold 7.5% over expected). Auto-alerts triggered, sending to #incidents and paging rotation. Runbook v2 invoked.

jordan_oncall: acked, I'm on it. any immediate customer-facing noise?

finance_ops: seeing ~120 customers received overage flags in the last 20m, most reports are delayed. Some are from EU region. Not all customers are impacted.

alex_chang: looking at emitter logs now — consumer group lags on kafka-ingest-3, offsets behind ~120k. Possible stalled consumer or GC on a node.

maria_gonzalez: oncall checklist: are token counters doubling or missing? quick parity check between shadow and prod tables?

jordan_oncall: running parity: `select sum(tokens) from prod_shard where ts > now() - interval '1 hour'` vs `shadow_agg` — returning ~8.9% delta (prod > shadow).

alex_chang: ok consumer is healthy but one router (router-22 GKE) is showing repeated HTTP 502s to emitter-service. Restarting router-22.

incident-bot: deploybot: restart initiated for pod router-22 in cluster-prod-eu (k8s).

sam_ops: restarted, logs show emitter-service 504s for a ~3m window before restart. There were retries which may have caused duplicate ack behavior upstream.

jordan_oncall: are we sure duplicates cause higher token counts? Could be replay or windowing. Check idempotency keys on emitter.

alex_chang: grep of emitter logs: `duplicate request id=<redacted> attempt=2` appears ~11k times in that window. Looks like the client retried without backoff due to upstream timeout.

maria_gonzalez: quick mitigation: enable safe-dedupe mode in emitter (config flag) to ignore retries for 10m. Also temporarily pause alerts to customers so we don't spam them while we investigate.

finance_ops: please pause automated overage emails — doing that now (smtp-suppress = true). Hold message templates.

jordan_oncall: toggled emitter.dedupe=true in feature flags for EU and paused billing-alert-sender. Confirming config push.

incident-bot: config-change: feature-flag push successful to EU clusters.

alex_chang: while dedupe is on, starting a supervised dry backfill to recompute token totals from raw events for the impacted window. Running with `--max-concurrency=20`. Estimated 25m.

sam_ops: also enabling ingress retry budget reduction to avoid bursts that might re-trigger duplicates.

maria_gonzalez: customer impact summary for status page: "We are investigating a metering discrepancy affecting a subset of customers in EU causing temporary overage notifications. Billing is paused while we remediate. No confirmed incorrect charges yet." Any objections?

jordan_oncall: fine, post that.

finance_ops: after backfill starts, we'll reconcile counts and prepare a targeted customer list for outreach if any customers had incorrect transient flags.

alex_chang: backfill progress: 10% done, estimated 20m remaining. Preliminary numbers show corrected delta dropping to 1.2% as we re-aggregate.

incident-bot: alert cleared: dedupe + backfill mitigations show metrics trending to baseline. Please coordinate postmortem and customer comms.

jordan_oncall: wrapping up: create incident ticket, tag eng-runtime, eng-ml (metering), finance, and cs. Assign follow-up action items: (1) add stricter idempotency tests to emitter (owner: alex), (2) add retry-budget alarms to routing (owner: sam), (3) add billing-safety-gate to block alert sends during abnormal deltas (owner: maria).

maria_gonzalez: adding to runbook: if >5% drift and >50 customers flagged, auto-suppress outgoing billing alerts until manual review.

finance_ops: will prep drafts for any customers we need to contact and coordinate refund/credits process if needed.

jordan_oncall: thanks team — marking this thread resolved, follow-ups in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
